entries.claim: Range Avoidance asks for a point outside the range of a stretching circuit, and uniform output sampling is the natural randomized baseline.
Algorithms for appropriate Range-Avoidance classes imply explicit constructions and lower-bound consequences.
NC0_2-Avoid has deterministic polynomial-time algorithms at positive stretch.
MONOTONE-NC0_3-Avoid is deterministic polynomial time for m>n.
Clause redundancy and irredundant equivalent subsets are established for CNF.
Redundancy and IES questions for 2-CNF are established prior art.
UCP-irredundant CNF is an established neighboring notion.
Boolean CSP solution graphs, connectivity and component diameter are established research topics.
Pure AND_k circuits with m>n admit an explicit separator of degree at most k+1.
sources: V54 internal proof and two verifiers

entries.claim: Arbitrary mixtures of efficiently represented affine output fibers are avoidable deterministically in polynomial time for m>n.
sources: V56 internal proof and two verifiers

entries.claim: Five orbit-0x07 gate-fiber blocks on four variables are jointly consistent and completely block-irredundant, and direct sums give an infinite stretch-one family.
sources: V57 direct proof, exhaustive search and independent verifier

entries.claim: Orientation depth d yields an m^{O(d)} poly(n+m) deterministic algorithm for bijunctive fibers.
sources: V58 internal proof, exact audit and independent verifier

entries.claim: The internal boundary of a set occupying at most half the cube has fraction at least binom(m,floor(m/2))/2^(m-1).
The V57 direct-sum family is flat for exact forced count, unit-propagation count and exact fiber size on the first boundary step.
When image membership is polynomial-time and m>n, uniform output sampling finds a missing word in at most two expected trials.
